This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.846 of the raw projection. It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1101 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.971 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Tigers attack ×0.989, defense ×0.985 (7 games); Jaguars attack ×0.977, defense ×0.985 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 19.6 points), no bet.
